title: Python Basics
description: A complete beginner-to-solid-fundamentals path through Python — syntax, data structures, functions, files, and OOP essentials.

changelog.notes: Initial release — 24 decks across 7 sections, foundations through OOP essentials.
Added an explanation to every card, shown when an answer is wrong.
Fixed a set-union card whose "|" answer couldn't be typed in this CSV format.

Cut typing-required cards from 72% to 7.5% by converting most code_fill/command_output/type_answer cards to tap-to-answer equivalents (select_blank, multiple_choice, true_false) — review now stays quick to tap through. Trimmed one over-length prompt and fixed two decks whose practice cards were all one type.
Added a narrated media_card to every deck (24 total) that pronounces and defines that deck's key term — key vocabulary now has real audio for a learner who prefers listening.

Shortened every prompt to under 10 words and every multiple-choice-style option to under 3 words (129 of 184 cards), so a card reads at a glance instead of needing a scroll — compacted code snippets and split a couple of two-class demos into simpler true/false checks. No fact changes.

Added a preview card to every deck (24 total) — a one-time, plain-language explanation of that deck's concept shown right before its first graded attempt, so the idea is introduced before you're tested on it.
